subject: Social Media
title: Rage Bait Economics
description: A quick, practical guide to Rage Bait Economics.

hook.text: A food blogger deliberately cooks pasta wrong. Italians rage. Millions of views. She profits from fury.

buildup.text: Rage bait is content designed to anger a specific group. The creator wants hate-engagement, not love.

discovery.text: Algorithms can't tell angry clicks from happy ones. Rage engagement counts the same. Revenue flows.

twist.text: A cottage industry of rage bait emerged. Creators deliberately offend communities for algorithmic reward.

climax.text: Responding to rage bait amplifies it. The only winning move is to not engage—but outrage is addictive.

punchline.text: Your anger is someone else's paycheck.

quiz.question: Why does rage bait succeed economically?
options: Algorithms treat angry engagement the same as positive
Rage bait is cheaper to produce
